stages.warning: Host scope is inferred because the IFC export contains no explicit product host relationship.

issue_groups.title: Ceiling services moved with the ceiling
issue_groups.before: Ceiling services were coordinated at the previous ceiling elevation.
issue_groups.after: The ceiling zone and its hosted fixtures, devices, terminals, and attached port context move down 150 mm together.
issue_groups.why: Keeps the visible ceiling plane, service devices, and connectivity context aligned.
issue_groups.validation: Affected world deltas match the request; original STEP IDs and GlobalIds remain preserved.

issue_groups.title: Ceiling access added where services need it
issue_groups.before: Mechanical equipment and valves lacked a coordinated access path through the ceiling presentation.
issue_groups.after: 32 600 × 600 mm access panels are represented, with 224 IFC records covering panels, openings, relationships, and access properties.
issue_groups.why: Makes future inspection and service access visible and traceable in the model.
issue_groups.validation: Every selected target is covered; panel geometry fits its host ceiling; created relationships validate.

issue_groups.title: A dedicated conduit bay now runs below the beams
issue_groups.before: Electrical reservation space competed with the service routes in the hallway.
issue_groups.after: A 4 ft wide × 6 in deep route is reserved as high as possible below the beams, with 2 in Unistrut below.
issue_groups.why: Gives the electrical route a clear, inspectable zone and an explicit support interface.
issue_groups.metric: 1.219 m wide · 0.152 m deep · 0.051 m support
issue_groups.validation: Bay clearance and beam clearance checks passed; the route system is present in the revised IFC.

issue_groups.title: Duct cells were shifted without changing size
issue_groups.before: Selected duct cells conflicted with the new electrical reservation.
issue_groups.after: Affected ducts and their standard fittings move as connected cells; size signatures remain unchanged.
issue_groups.why: Preserves airflow design intent while giving the hallway route room to work.
issue_groups.validation: Duct size signatures unchanged; fitting operations are captured in the edit manifest.

issue_groups.title: Piping is consolidated low along the north wall
issue_groups.before: Main piping and cross-hall tap windows occupied competing elevations.
issue_groups.after: Glycol, mechanical, and domestic routes use the low north-wall rack, with top tap windows lowered to keep the electrical route above.
issue_groups.why: Creates a readable service rack and leaves the hallway center available for other systems.
issue_groups.validation: North-wall main checks passed; top-tap orientation was preserved in the coordination evidence.

issue_groups.title: Fire-protection branches clear the lighting envelope
issue_groups.before: Fire-protection branches crossed the lighting coordination zone.
issue_groups.after: Branches lift where beam clearance permits and the transverse branch stays below the conduit bay while clearing lighting.
issue_groups.why: Protects the life-safety route and keeps ceiling lighting serviceable.
issue_groups.validation: Fire branches clear lighting; sprinkler main adjacency to mechanical mains passed.

unresolved_or_contextual.label: Browser geometry is a derived display layer
unresolved_or_contextual.detail: The comparison view selects glTF meshes through stable IFC STEP IDs and the scene bridge; IFC and graph manifests remain the source of truth.

schema_documentation.issue_groups: Human-readable coordination topics. Each group points to change_ids and focus_step_ids.
schema_documentation.changes: Element or IFC-record-level comparison entries with status, before/after summary, technical trace, and source provenance.
schema_documentation.graph: True nodes-and-edges graph. Issue and system labels are human-readable; element nodes retain stable STEP and GlobalId values in technical metadata.
schema_documentation.trace: step_id and global_id identify IFC identity; geometry_id, USD path, and glTF node name identify derived display identity; hashes identify before/after evidence.
schema_documentation.units: Distances in the comparison payload use metres unless a field ends with _mm; the presentation uses millimetres and feet/inches where useful.

source_integration.no_draco_warning: The accepted source browser GLB uses uncompressed primitives; no KHR_draco_mesh_compression extension is required.

quarantined_legacy_source.reason: Existing generic files are retained as historical ceiling-down payloads and are excluded from authoritative before/after source selection.
